title: Alphabet 2050亿美元支出目标引发市场疑虑
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mandy, if you want to focus on Alphabet, let's just sit on that name right there.
segments.zh: Mandy，如果聚焦Alphabet，我们就先看这只权益资产。

segments.en: With those names reporting good numbers or what? When I look at Alphabet and I look at the individual divisions, they put up some decent results. I did, and you know, for a company of Alphabet
segments.zh: 这些公司业绩不错？看Alphabet各业务部门，成绩可观。对于Alphabet这种体量的公司，

segments.en: size to grow 24 percent top line, it's just phenomenal. And, you know, cloud segment had margins
segments.zh: 营收增长24%非常惊人。云业务利润率几乎翻倍。

segments.en: almost double compared to last year. So you can't make the case that, you know, there is no ROIC on this CapEx when that cloud business, which was growing 25 to 30 percent before, is now growing
segments.zh: 不能说资本支出没有回报，云业务增速从25-30%升至80%以上，利润率翻倍。

segments.en: 80 percent plus, and your margins have doubled. So from that perspective, I think they have earned the right to spend more. And they talked about how they have to rent compute capacity from
segments.zh: 因此他们有权增加支出。他们提到短期内需向SpaceX等租用算力，可能拉低利润率。

segments.en: the likes of SpaceX and NEO clouds in the near term, which may drag the margins down a little bit.
segments.zh: 这是一家全栈公司，云业务几年前还不存在，现在却驱动增长，24%的增速非常惊人。

segments.en: And this is a full vertical stack company, and you know, the cloud business was non-existent a few years back, and now that's what's driving the growth, and 24 percent is just phenomenal.
segments.zh: Mandy，今早我纠结的是：我理解资本支出来源的担忧，但数据本身证明了支出的合理性。

segments.en: Mandy, that's my struggle this morning. I understand the concerns about CapEx where the money's coming from, but the numbers themselves justify the spending. So when I see the stock down in the pre-market,
segments.zh: 所以看到盘前股价下跌，我在想：是仓位调整？价格因素？还是公司财报有根本问题？

segments.en: I'm just trying to work out. Is that all about positioning? Is that just about price? Or is it actually something fundamental about whatever the company reported overnight?
segments.zh: 我只是想弄清楚，这完全是关于仓位调整吗？还是仅仅关于价格？或者实际上与该公司隔夜报告的基本面有关？
